name: Esther Orga
headline: Every Child Deserves A Future
description: Esther's journey reflects the reality faced by many vulnerable children and families across underserved communities.
Despite the challenges surrounding education, healthcare and daily living, her resilience continues to inspire hope.
Through compassionate intervention and community support, lives like Esther's can be transformed into stories of opportunity and lasting impact.
whyStoryMatters: Esther's story represents countless children and families whose futures can change when compassionate people choose to act. Every contribution creates opportunities for education, healthcare, protection and hope.
